description.en: Armbian 26.8.6 for Radxa ROCK 5 ITX. Debian 13 (Trixie), minimal command-line image, ARM64, vendor kernel 6.1.172. Built and maintained by Armbian; software retains its respective upstream copyrights and licenses. This custom ROOBI source writes the disk image only and does not update SPI firmware. A compatible bootloader is required, especially for NVMe/SATA boot. Installation erases the selected target disk. https://www.armbian.com/rock-5-itx/
